# 3Dmol.js

`3Dmol-2.5.5.min.js` is the unmodified `build/3Dmol-min.js` from the
[3dmol 2.5.5 npm release](https://registry.npmjs.org/3dmol/-/3dmol-2.5.5.tgz).
The package's [BSD license and dependency notices](./3Dmol-LICENSE.txt)
are included alongside it. Upstream: <https://github.com/3dmol/3Dmol.js>.

The pinned bundle is loaded only when a reader enables the interaction
atlas. The renderer and molecular data are served by the documentation site;
viewing the examples makes no requests to a CDN or structure service.
